Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: Ápa _____, the Peshwa's viceroy, remonstrated with Momín Khán for this breach of faith
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: Ápa Ganesh, the Peshwa's viceroy, remonstrated with Momín Khán for this breach of faith.

Gujarat under Alamgir II.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: In reply his envoy was shown the despatch received from _____, and was made the bearer of a message, that before it was too late, it would be wisdom for the Maráthás to abandon Gujarát
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: Taking advantage of the confusion that followed, the Delhi court despatched instructions to the chief Mughal nobles of Gujarát, directing Momín Khán, Jawán Mard Khán, and the governor of Bharuch to join in driving the Maráthás out of the province. In reply his envoy was shown the despatch received from Delhi, and was made the bearer of a message, that before it was too late, it would be wisdom for the Maráthás to abandon Gujarát.

Gujarat under Alamgir II.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: Things were in this state when Dámáji Gáikwár, wisely forgetting his quarrels with the _____, marched to the aid of Sadáshiv with a large army
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: Ápa Ganesh, the Peshwa's viceroy, remonstrated with Momín Khán for this breach of faith. Things were in this state when Dámáji Gáikwár, wisely forgetting his quarrels with the Peshwa, marched to the aid of Sadáshiv with a large army.

Gujarat under Alamgir II.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: Advancing against _____ he attacked and defeated Momín Khán, plundering one of his villages
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: Advancing against Cambay he attacked and defeated Momín Khán, plundering one of his villages.

Gujarat under Alamgir II.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: But the Maráthás were too weak to follow up this success, or exact severer punishment from the _____ confederates
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: But the Maráthás were too weak to follow up this success, or exact severer punishment from the Mughal confederates. Thus the Marathas completely took over Gujarat and Mughal rule ended.

Gujarat under Alamgir II.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: Ápa Ganesh invited Sardár _____án Bábi to Kaira, and on condition of the payment of tribute, agreed to allow him to keep possession of Bálásinor
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: Ápa Ganesh invited Sardár Muhammad Khán Bábi to Kaira, and on condition of the payment of tribute, agreed to allow him to keep possession of Bálásinor.

Gujarat under Alamgir II.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Alamgir II.question: Thus the _____ completely took over Gujarat and Mughal rule ended
Gujarat under Alamgir II.fact: Thus the Marathas completely took over Gujarat and Mughal rule ended.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The emperor Jahandar Shah who had come to power in _____ was defeated by his nephew Farrukhsiyar in put to death in 1713
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The emperor Jahandar Shah who had come to power in 1712 was defeated by his nephew Farrukhsiyar in put to death in 1713.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: As he was helped by noble _____ brothers, he was under their influence
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: As he was helped by noble Sayad brothers, he was under their influence.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He concluded treaty with _____ of Jodhpur
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He concluded treaty with Ajitsingh of Jodhpur. Ajitsingh was appointed as the next viceroy who had disputes with other noble Haidar Kúli Khán.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: After some reluctance, _____ let Khán Daurán Nasrat Jang Bahádur to be appointed as the next viceroy
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He concluded treaty with Ajitsingh of Jodhpur. Ajitsingh was appointed as the next viceroy who had disputes with other noble Haidar Kúli Khán.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Daud Khan Panni, the powerful general, was appointed as the viceroy but there were riots in Ahmedabad in _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Daud Khan Panni, the powerful general, was appointed as the viceroy but there were riots in Ahmedabad in 1714.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Ajitsingh was appointed as the next viceroy who had disputes with other noble _____ Kúli Khán
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Ajitsingh was appointed as the next viceroy who had disputes with other noble Haidar Kúli Khán.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: In _____, the emperor Farrukhsiyar was deposed by influential Sayad brothers in 1719
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: In 1719, the emperor Farrukhsiyar was deposed by influential Sayad brothers in 1719.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He was succeeded by short reigns of Rafi ud-Darajat and _____ II
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He was succeeded by short reigns of Rafi ud-Darajat and Shah Jahan II.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He put Jahandar Shah to death and mounted the throne in _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He put Jahandar Shah to death and mounted the throne in 1713.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: As he had been raised to the throne mainly by the aid of _____ Áli and Abdullah Khán, the new emperor fell under the power of these nobles
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: As he had been raised to the throne mainly by the aid of Sayads Husain Áli and Abdullah Khán, the new emperor fell under the power of these nobles.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Husain Áli was sent against Ajítsingh of Márwár, and concluded a treaty with that chief, whereby Ajítsingh engaged to send his son to court and to give his daughter to the emperor in marriage: and the
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Husain Áli was sent against Ajítsingh of Márwár, and concluded a treaty with that chief, whereby Ajítsingh engaged to send his son to court and to give his daughter to the emperor in marriage: and the marriage was solemnised in 1715.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: In _____, shortly after this treaty was concluded, Ajítsingh sent his son Abheysingh to court, and on him in place of one Sayad Áhmed Gíláni was conferred the post of governor of Sorath
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: In 1714, shortly after this treaty was concluded, Ajítsingh sent his son Abheysingh to court, and on him in place of one Sayad Áhmed Gíláni was conferred the post of governor of Sorath.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Abheysingh remained at court and sent his deputy Káyath _____ to Junagadh
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Abheysingh remained at court and sent his deputy Káyath Fatehsingh to Junagadh.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Abdúl Hamíd Khán was appointed revenue officer of _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Abdúl Hamíd Khán was appointed revenue officer of Surat. After some time he resigned his Surat office and went to court, where on being made superintendent of the shrine of Sheikh Ahmed Khattu, he returned to Áhmedábád.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: After some time he resigned his Surat office and went to court, where on being made superintendent of the shrine of _____, he returned to Áhmedábád
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: After some time he resigned his Surat office and went to court, where on being made superintendent of the shrine of Sheikh Ahmed Khattu, he returned to Áhmedábád.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: In _____, Muhtarim Khán was appointed to succeed him in Surat
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: In 1713, Muhtarim Khán was appointed to succeed him in Surat.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The reckless courage of Dáud Khán _____ was renowned throughout India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The reckless courage of Dáud Khán Panni was renowned throughout India.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: His memory survives in the tales and proverbs of the _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: His memory survives in the tales and proverbs of the Dakhan.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: So stern was his discipline that none of his _____án soldiers dared to touch a leaf of the standing crops where they were encamped
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: So stern was his discipline that none of his Afghán soldiers dared to touch a leaf of the standing crops where they were encamped.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: When at Áhmedábád, he was either engaged in scattering the _____ or in coursing with greyhounds
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: When at Áhmedábád, he was either engaged in scattering the Kolis or in coursing with greyhounds.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He preferred life under canvas on the Sábarmati sands to the viceregal surroundings of the _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He preferred life under canvas on the Sábarmati sands to the viceregal surroundings of the Bhadra Palace.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: His civil work he used to trust to _____áhmans and Pandits
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: His civil work he used to trust to Dakhan Bráhmans and Pandits.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Until Dáud Khán's arrival, Abdúl Hamíd Khán was appointed viceroy and took charge of the province from _____ámat Khán
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Until Dáud Khán's arrival, Abdúl Hamíd Khán was appointed viceroy and took charge of the province from Shahámat Khán.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: At this time, on the security of Rája _____ of Nágor, a sum of Rupees 50,000 was granted to the brother of Durgádás Ráthoḍ
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: At this time, on the security of Rája Muhkamsingh of Nágor, a sum of Rupees 50,000 was granted to the brother of Durgádás Ráthoḍ.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Aggrieved with this treatment the Muslim complained to a preacher of much eloquence and influence, _____ Áli
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Aggrieved with this treatment the Muslim complained to a preacher of much eloquence and influence, Mulla Muhammad Áli.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The preacher took the _____ to the Assembly Mosque and sent for Mulla Abdúl Âzíz the chief or leading member of the Sunni Bohra community
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Riots in Áhmedábád, 1714 In 1714, in Áhmedábád Harírám, the agent of Madan Gopál a successful North Indian banker, who came to Áhmedábád as treasurer with Fírúz Jang, while celebrating the Holi with his friends, seized a Muslim gentleman and handled him with great roughness. Aggrieved with this treatment the Muslim complained to a preacher of much eloquence and influence, Mulla Muhammad Áli.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He answered the call with a strong party of his men, and on his way was joined by numbers of _____ both soldiers and citizens
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He answered the call with a strong party of his men, and on his way was joined by numbers of Muslims both soldiers and citizens.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: With cries of ‘Dín’ ‘Dín’, they went to the mosque and carried off the insulted man and the priest and the _____ leader to the house of the Kázi Khair-ul-láh
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The preacher took the Muslim to the Assembly Mosque and sent for Mulla Abdúl Âzíz the chief or leading member of the Sunni Bohra community. With cries of ‘Dín’ ‘Dín’, they went to the mosque and carried off the insulted man and the priest and the Bohra leader to the house of the Kázi Khair-ul-láh.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The Kázi closed his doors against the crowd who returned abusing him to the _____ pillaging and killing as they went
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The Kázi closed his doors against the crowd who returned abusing him to the Ratanpol pillaging and killing as they went. They next swarmed towards Madan Gopál's Haveli in the Ratanpol.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: They next swarmed towards _____ál's Haveli in the Ratanpol
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: They next swarmed towards Madan Gopál's Haveli in the Ratanpol.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: But the _____áli closed its strong gates and with his Muslim soldiers met the swarm with firearms
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: But the Nagarsheth Kapurchand Bhansáli closed its strong gates and with his Muslim soldiers met the swarm with firearms. The emperor ordered mace-bearers to proceed to Gujarát and bring the Muslim ringleaders together with the Hindu Nagarsheth Kapurchand Bhansáli.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The viceroy who was camped at the _____ sent soldiers and under the influence of the leading citizens of both classes, the disturbance was quelled
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The viceroy who was camped at the Shahibaug sent soldiers and under the influence of the leading citizens of both classes, the disturbance was quelled.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: When the particulars of the riots were known in the imperial camp, the Hindus, clamouring against _____ Áli and Sheikh Abdúl Âzíz Gujaráti, struck business and closed their shops
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: When the particulars of the riots were known in the imperial camp, the Hindus, clamouring against Mulla Muhammad Áli and Sheikh Abdúl Âzíz Gujaráti, struck business and closed their shops.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The emperor ordered mace-bearers to proceed to Gujarát and bring the Muslim ringleaders together with the _____áli
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The emperor ordered mace-bearers to proceed to Gujarát and bring the Muslim ringleaders together with the Hindu Nagarsheth Kapurchand Bhansáli.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Some Bohras at the imperial camp, sending advance-news to Áhmedábád, the Mullah, and the _____ and after him, the Bhansáli started for the imperial camp
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Some Bohras at the imperial camp, sending advance-news to Áhmedábád, the Mullah, and the Bohra Sheth and after him, the Bhansáli started for the imperial camp.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: On reaching the camp the Mulla, who was very impressive and eloquent, preached a sermon in the _____ and his fame reaching the emperor, he was called to court and asked to preach
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: On reaching the camp the Mulla, who was very impressive and eloquent, preached a sermon in the Assembly Mosque and his fame reaching the emperor, he was called to court and asked to preach.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He and the _____ were now able to explain their case to the emperor and the Bhansáli was imprisoned
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The emperor ordered mace-bearers to proceed to Gujarát and bring the Muslim ringleaders together with the Hindu Nagarsheth Kapurchand Bhansáli. Some Bohras at the imperial camp, sending advance-news to Áhmedábád, the Mullah, and the Bohra Sheth and after him, the Bhansáli started for the imperial camp.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: It is said that the _____áli made the Mulla the medium of his release and that he and the Bohra returned to Gujarát while the Mulla remained in honour at court till he died
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Some Bohras at the imperial camp, sending advance-news to Áhmedábád, the Mullah, and the Bohra Sheth and after him, the Bhansáli started for the imperial camp. He and the Sheth were now able to explain their case to the emperor and the Bhansáli was imprisoned.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Dáud Khán, the viceroy now went into _____ and Nawanaagr to collect tribute, and on his return to Áhmedábád, married the daughter of the chief of Halvad in the Jhalawad
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Dáud Khán, the viceroy now went into Kathiawad and Nawanaagr to collect tribute, and on his return to Áhmedábád, married the daughter of the chief of Halvad in the Jhalawad.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He introduced _____ pandits into official posts, who levied a fee called chithyáman from landholders and took taxes from the holdings of Sayads and otherwise made themselves unpopular
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He introduced Dakhani pandits into official posts, who levied a fee called chithyáman from landholders and took taxes from the holdings of Sayads and otherwise made themselves unpopular.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: About this time Momín Khán, governor of Surat, arrived in Gujarát, and placing his deputies in Petlád, Dholka, Baroda, and Naḍiád, went himself to Surat in _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: About this time Momín Khán, governor of Surat, arrived in Gujarát, and placing his deputies in Petlád, Dholka, Baroda, and Naḍiád, went himself to Surat in 1715. There were Hindu-Muslim riots again in Ahmedabad in 1715.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: There were Hindu-Muslim riots again in Ahmedabad in _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: About this time Momín Khán, governor of Surat, arrived in Gujarát, and placing his deputies in Petlád, Dholka, Baroda, and Naḍiád, went himself to Surat in 1715. There were Hindu-Muslim riots again in Ahmedabad in 1715.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Here he was opposed by the commandant of the fort, _____án, who was obliged to give way, his subordinate, Sayad Kásim, being defeated by Fidá-ud-dín Khán
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Here he was opposed by the commandant of the fort, Zia Khán, who was obliged to give way, his subordinate, Sayad Kásim, being defeated by Fidá-ud-dín Khán.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: On this account, and for other reasons, Dáud Khán was recalled, and _____án Jhálori was directed to act in his place until the arrival of a new viceroy
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: On this account, and for other reasons, Dáud Khán was recalled, and Ghazni Khán Jhálori was directed to act in his place until the arrival of a new viceroy.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Ajítsingh sent Vajeráj Bhandári to act as his deputy until his arrival, and _____ Káyath was chosen deputy governor of Sorath
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Ajítsingh sent Vajeráj Bhandári to act as his deputy until his arrival, and Fatehsingh Káyath was chosen deputy governor of Sorath.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Haidar Kúli chose an officer to act for him as minister, and after appointing deputies in his different charges himself went to _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Perhaps one of the most remarkable appointments of this time was that of Haidar Kúli Khán to be minister as well as military commandant of Baroda, Nándod, Arhar-Mátar (in Kheda district), and of the ports of Surat and Cambay. Haidar Kúli chose an officer to act for him as minister, and after appointing deputies in his different charges himself went to Surat.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: During this year an imperial order conferred on Haidar Kúli Khán, Sorath and _____ or south-east Kathiawad then in charge of Fatehsingh, the viceroy's deputy
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: During this year an imperial order conferred on Haidar Kúli Khán, Sorath and Gohilwad or south-east Kathiawad then in charge of Fatehsingh, the viceroy's deputy.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: On receiving this order _____ sent Sayad Âkil as his deputy, and that officer went to Jambusar, and, collecting men, set out to join his appointment
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Haidar Kúli chose an officer to act for him as minister, and after appointing deputies in his different charges himself went to Surat. During this year an imperial order conferred on Haidar Kúli Khán, Sorath and Gohilwad or south-east Kathiawad then in charge of Fatehsingh, the viceroy's deputy.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: He first camped at Loliánah, where the province of Sorath begins, and from Loliánah marched against _____ and plundered the town
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He first camped at Loliánah, where the province of Sorath begins, and from Loliánah marched against Palitana and plundered the town.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: By the help of Salábat Khán Bábi, the deputy in _____, matters were arranged, and Sayad Âkil returned from Sorath
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: By the help of Salábat Khán Bábi, the deputy in Gohilwad, matters were arranged, and Sayad Âkil returned from Sorath.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Haidar was anxious to send Salábat Khán as deputy to _____
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: He first camped at Loliánah, where the province of Sorath begins, and from Loliánah marched against Palitana and plundered the town. Disagreement between the Viceroy and Haidar Kúli Khán, 1715 The viceroy, who was by no means well disposed to Haidar Kúli Khán, sent a message that if any injury was done in Sorath he would take vengeance on the aggressors; and as neither Ajítsingh nor Haidar Kúli Khán was of a very compliant temper, civil war was on the point of breaking out.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: But as Salábat demanded too high a salary, Raza Kúli, brother of the late governor of _____, was chosen
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: But as Salábat demanded too high a salary, Raza Kúli, brother of the late governor of Baroda, was chosen. After this Haidar Kúli Khán, in company with Kázím Beg, governor of Baroda, marched against and defeated the chief of Munjpur (near Rádhanpur), who had refused to pay the usual tribute.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: When this officer, with his brother Maâsúm Kúli, reached Amreli, _____, the viceroy's deputy, evacuated Junágaḍh
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: When this officer, with his brother Maâsúm Kúli, reached Amreli, Fatehsingh, the viceroy's deputy, evacuated Junágaḍh.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: After this _____ Kúli Khán, in company with Kázím Beg, governor of Baroda, marched against and defeated the chief of Munjpur (near Rádhanpur), who had refused to pay the usual tribute
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Haidar was anxious to send Salábat Khán as deputy to Sorath. After this Haidar Kúli Khán, in company with Kázím Beg, governor of Baroda, marched against and defeated the chief of Munjpur (near Rádhanpur), who had refused to pay the usual tribute.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: The viceroy went to _____ to collect the imperial revenue, and, owing to his excessive demands, met with armed resistance from the Jám of Nawanagar
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: The viceroy went to Sorath to collect the imperial revenue, and, owing to his excessive demands, met with armed resistance from the Jám of Nawanagar.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: Finally, the matter of tribute was settled, and after visiting the shrine of _____, the viceroy returned to Áhmedábád
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: Finally, the matter of tribute was settled, and after visiting the shrine of Dwarka, the viceroy returned to Áhmedábád.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: On the arrival of the army, Ajítsingh marched straight on Áhmedábád and encamped at Sarkhej, but _____án persuaded him to retire to Jodhpur without giving battle
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: On the arrival of the army, Ajítsingh marched straight on Áhmedábád and encamped at Sarkhej, but Nahar Khán persuaded him to retire to Jodhpur without giving battle.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.question: In _____, after the departure of Ajítsingh, Haidar Kúli Khan, who had been appointed deputy viceroy, leaving Surat set out for Áhmedábád
Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.fact: In 1717, after the departure of Ajítsingh, Haidar Kúli Khan, who had been appointed deputy viceroy, leaving Surat set out for Áhmedábád.

Gujarat under Farrukhsiyar.subject: Ancient India

Meanwhile, in Gujarát dissensions sprang up between Hámid Khán and other officers, but matters were arranged without any outbreak of hostility.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Tribute was exacted from the chiefs on the banks of the Vatrak river and from _____ an unruly Koli village was burned down, and garrisons were placed in the Koli country
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Tribute was exacted from the chiefs on the banks of the Vatrak river and from Modhera an unruly Koli village was burned down, and garrisons were placed in the Koli country.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: In _____ Rustam Áli Khán and Shujáât Khán were ordered from Delhi to march on Jodhpur, which they captured and plundered, and then returned to Áhmedábád
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: In 1723 Rustam Áli Khán and Shujáât Khán were ordered from Delhi to march on Jodhpur, which they captured and plundered, and then returned to Áhmedábád. Marathas return In 1723, Piláji Gáikwár, who had been long hovering on the frontier, marched on Surat and was opposed by Momín Khán, whom he defeated.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Marathas return In _____, Piláji Gáikwár, who had been long hovering on the frontier, marched on Surat and was opposed by Momín Khán, whom he defeated
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: In 1723 Rustam Áli Khán and Shujáât Khán were ordered from Delhi to march on Jodhpur, which they captured and plundered, and then returned to Áhmedábád. Marathas return In 1723, Piláji Gáikwár, who had been long hovering on the frontier, marched on Surat and was opposed by Momín Khán, whom he defeated.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: At the same time Kántáji _____ Bánde, invading Gujarát from the side of Dahod, began to levy fixed contributions
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: At the same time Kántáji Kadam Bánde, invading Gujarát from the side of Dahod, began to levy fixed contributions.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Though before this occasional demands had often been made, _____ was the first year in which the Maráthás imposed a regular tribute on Gujarát
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Marathas return In 1723, Piláji Gáikwár, who had been long hovering on the frontier, marched on Surat and was opposed by Momín Khán, whom he defeated. Though before this occasional demands had often been made, 1723 was the first year in which the Maráthás imposed a regular tribute on Gujarát.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Momín Khán was now appointed provincial minister, and _____ Áli Khán succeeded him as revenue officer of Surat
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Momín Khán was now appointed provincial minister, and Rustam Áli Khán succeeded him as revenue officer of Surat.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: He selected _____áât Khán as his deputy, and made other arrangements for the government of the province
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: He selected Shujáât Khán as his deputy, and made other arrangements for the government of the province. Hámid Khán, uncle and deputy of the Nizám, prepared to oppose Shujáât Khán, but through the intervention of Bábis Salábat Khán, Safdar Khán, and Jawán Mard Khán, Hámid Khán evacuated the Bhadra, and withdrew to Dahod.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Shujáât Khán now went to collect tribute, leaving Ibráhím Kúli Khán at Áhmedábád, while Rámrái was posted at _____ in Kaira, with orders to watch the movements of Hámid Khán
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shujáât Khán now went to collect tribute, leaving Ibráhím Kúli Khán at Áhmedábád, while Rámrái was posted at Mahudha in Kaira, with orders to watch the movements of Hámid Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: As the viceroy was in need of money, he farmed to one Jívan Jugal the districts of _____, Makbúlábad or Amod about twenty-two miles north of Bharuch, Dholka, and Bharuch
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: As the viceroy was in need of money, he farmed to one Jívan Jugal the districts of Jambusar, Makbúlábad or Amod about twenty-two miles north of Bharuch, Dholka, and Bharuch.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: In _____, he came to Áhmedábád with Áli Muhammad Khán father of the author of the Mirát-i-Áhmedi, as his private minister
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: In 1724, he came to Áhmedábád with Áli Muhammad Khán father of the author of the Mirát-i-Áhmedi, as his private minister.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: The emperor accepted this offer, allowing _____ Áli to draw on the Surat treasury to the extent of Rupees 200000
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Rustam Áli, governor of Surat, having succeeded twice or thrice in defeating the Maráthás under Píláji Gáikwár, now offered, in conjunction with his brother Shujáât Khán, that if 20,000 men were placed under their orders, they would march against the Nizám. The emperor accepted this offer, allowing Rustam Áli to draw on the Surat treasury to the extent of Rupees 200000.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: He promised to Kántáji _____ Bánde a one-fourth share of the revenue of Gujarát, provided he should be able, in concert with Hámid Khán, to re-conquer the province from Mubáriz-ul-Mulk
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: He promised to Kántáji Kadam Bánde a one-fourth share of the revenue of Gujarát, provided he should be able, in concert with Hámid Khán, to re-conquer the province from Mubáriz-ul-Mulk. Hámid Khán seeing his opportunity, united his forces with those of Kántáji Kadam, and marched to Kapadvanj.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Shujáât Khán, who was now at Kadi, instead of following the advice of his minister and carefully watching Hámid Khán's movements from _____, went to a distant part of the province
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shujáât Khán, who was now at Kadi, instead of following the advice of his minister and carefully watching Hámid Khán's movements from Kapadvanj, went to a distant part of the province. Hámid Khán seeing his opportunity, united his forces with those of Kántáji Kadam, and marched to Kapadvanj.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán seeing his opportunity, united his forces with those of Kántáji Kadam, and marched to _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shujáât Khán, who was now at Kadi, instead of following the advice of his minister and carefully watching Hámid Khán's movements from Kapadvanj, went to a distant part of the province. Hámid Khán seeing his opportunity, united his forces with those of Kántáji Kadam, and marched to Kapadvanj.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Shujáât Khán hearing of this, advanced towards Áhmedábád and encamped at _____ near Áhmedábád and then proceeded to Mota Medra, about six miles east of the capital
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shujáât Khán hearing of this, advanced towards Áhmedábád and encamped at Dabhoda near Áhmedábád and then proceeded to Mota Medra, about six miles east of the capital.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán seeing that _____áât Khán had but a small force, marched between him and the capital
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shujáât Khán hearing of this, advanced towards Áhmedábád and encamped at Dabhoda near Áhmedábád and then proceeded to Mota Medra, about six miles east of the capital. Hámid Khán seeing that Shujáât Khán had but a small force, marched between him and the capital.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: A battle was fought, in which Shujáât Khán was slain, and his two sons Hasan Kúli and _____ Kúli were taken prisoners
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: A battle was fought, in which Shujáât Khán was slain, and his two sons Hasan Kúli and Mustafa Kúli were taken prisoners.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Shujáât Khán's head was cut off and sent to _____án Bábi, to be sent to Ibráhím Kúli his son, who was doing duty as commandant at Áhmedábád
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shujáât Khán's head was cut off and sent to Safdar Khán Bábi, to be sent to Ibráhím Kúli his son, who was doing duty as commandant at Áhmedábád.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán now sent a message to the emperor, that the Maráthás had been successful in defeating _____áât Khán and conquering Gujarát, but that he had defended Áhmedábád against them
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: A battle was fought, in which Shujáât Khán was slain, and his two sons Hasan Kúli and Mustafa Kúli were taken prisoners. Shujáât Khán's head was cut off and sent to Safdar Khán Bábi, to be sent to Ibráhím Kúli his son, who was doing duty as commandant at Áhmedábád.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Kántáji went to _____ and besieged the town, but on the promise of one of the chief inhabitants to raise a sum of Rupees 350000, the Maráthás retired
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Kántáji went to Viramgam and besieged the town, but on the promise of one of the chief inhabitants to raise a sum of Rupees 350000, the Maráthás retired.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Ibráhím Kúli, son of _____áât Khán, in revenge for his father's death, determined to assassinate Hámid Khán
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Ibráhím Kúli, son of Shujáât Khán, in revenge for his father's death, determined to assassinate Hámid Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Píláji promised to aid _____án, and the allied armies, crossing the Mahi River, encamped at Aras in the plain between Anand Anand and the Mahi
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Píláji promised to aid Rustam Khán, and the allied armies, crossing the Mahi River, encamped at Aras in the plain between Anand Anand and the Mahi. Hámid Khán, accompanied by Mír Nathu, Muhammad Salábat Rohila, and Kántáji Kadam, marched to oppose Rustam Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán, accompanied by Mír Nathu, _____ábat Rohila, and Kántáji Kadam, marched to oppose Rustam Khán
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Hámid Khán, accompanied by Mír Nathu, Muhammad Salábat Rohila, and Kántáji Kadam, marched to oppose Rustam Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: A battle was fought, in which, though Piláji took no part, Hámid Khán was defeated and put to flight, and Mír _____ was killed
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Hámid Khán, accompanied by Mír Nathu, Muhammad Salábat Rohila, and Kántáji Kadam, marched to oppose Rustam Khán. A battle was fought, in which, though Piláji took no part, Hámid Khán was defeated and put to flight, and Mír Nathu was killed.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: After the fight _____ Áli remained on the field of battle and liberated his nephews, plundering Hámid Khán's camp
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Hámid Khán, accompanied by Mír Nathu, Muhammad Salábat Rohila, and Kántáji Kadam, marched to oppose Rustam Khán. After the fight Rustam Áli remained on the field of battle and liberated his nephews, plundering Hámid Khán's camp.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Píláji plundered _____ Áli's camp and then moved off, while Kántáji carried away what was left in the camp of Hámid Khán
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: After the fight Rustam Áli remained on the field of battle and liberated his nephews, plundering Hámid Khán's camp. Píláji plundered Rustam Áli's camp and then moved off, while Kántáji carried away what was left in the camp of Hámid Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Now, as the Maráthás really desired to ruin _____ Áli, who was their bitter foe, they after a few days surrounded him and cut off his supplies
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: After the fight Rustam Áli remained on the field of battle and liberated his nephews, plundering Hámid Khán's camp. Píláji plundered Rustam Áli's camp and then moved off, while Kántáji carried away what was left in the camp of Hámid Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán reproached Kántáji for his inactivity; but he pleaded in excuse that he was watching the mode of warfare amongst _____, and promised to attack Rustam Áli shortly
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Hámid Khán reproached Kántáji for his inactivity; but he pleaded in excuse that he was watching the mode of warfare amongst Mughals, and promised to attack Rustam Áli shortly.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: He extorted large sums from the rich, and poisoned the two sons of _____áât Khán
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: He extorted large sums from the rich, and poisoned the two sons of Shujáât Khán.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: When the news of Kántáji's and Píláji's success reached the Dakhan, _____, son of Khanderáv Senápati, came with a large army and laid siege to Cambay
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: When the news of Kántáji's and Píláji's success reached the Dakhan, Trimbak Rao Dabhade, son of Khanderáv Senápati, came with a large army and laid siege to Cambay.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk recaptures the province from Hamid Khan and the Maráthás, _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk recaptures the province from Hamid Khan and the Maráthás, 1725.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Salábat Khán, leaving Áhmedábád, went to Víramgám, and after some time, placing his nephew at Víramgám, he went into _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Salábat Khán, leaving Áhmedábád, went to Víramgám, and after some time, placing his nephew at Víramgám, he went into Gohilwad.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: When the news of the defeat and death of _____ Áli reached Delhi, the emperor ordered Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to take a strong army and proceed in person to Gujarát and expel Hámid Khán and the Maráthás
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: When the news of the defeat and death of Rustam Áli reached Delhi, the emperor ordered Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to take a strong army and proceed in person to Gujarát and expel Hámid Khán and the Maráthás.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk marched on Gujarát with a large army, assisted by Mahárája _____ of Jodhpur, Chatarsingh Rája of Narwar in Bundelkhand, Gandrapsingh, and the Mahárána of Udaipur
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk marched on Gujarát with a large army, assisted by Mahárája Abheysingh of Jodhpur, Chatarsingh Rája of Narwar in Bundelkhand, Gandrapsingh, and the Mahárána of Udaipur.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: At that time Salábat Khán was removed from his government, and _____án Bábi died
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: At that time Salábat Khán was removed from his government, and Safdar Khán Bábi died.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: In obedience to the imperial order, Mubáriz-ul-_____ marched from Ajmer and came to the Gujarát frontier
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk marched on Gujarát with a large army, assisted by Mahárája Abheysingh of Jodhpur, Chatarsingh Rája of Narwar in Bundelkhand, Gandrapsingh, and the Mahárána of Udaipur. On his arrival at Ajmer, Mubáriz-ul-Mulk was received by his private minister Áli Muhammad Khán, who afterwards joined Jawán Mard Khán Bábi in Rádhanpur, and united their troops with those under Mubáriz-ul-Mulk.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: He placed Rúpsingh and Sardár _____ in charge of the city and himself withdrew to Mehmúdábád
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: He placed Rúpsingh and Sardár Muhammad Ghorni in charge of the city and himself withdrew to Mehmúdábád. When Sheikh Alíyár arrived before the city, Muhammad Ghorni, who was dissatisfied with Hámid Khán for bringing in the Maráthás, persuaded Rúpsingh to fly.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk now sent _____íyár in advance with an army against Áhmedábád
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk now sent Sheikh Alíyár in advance with an army against Áhmedábád. When Sheikh Alíyár arrived before the city, Muhammad Ghorni, who was dissatisfied with Hámid Khán for bringing in the Maráthás, persuaded Rúpsingh to fly.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: In the meantime Mubáriz-ul-Mulk with the main body of his forces reached _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: In the meantime Mubáriz-ul-Mulk with the main body of his forces reached Sidhpur.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán, accompanied by a detachment of Marátha horse, now returned to Áhmedábád; but _____ closed the gates, and would not suffer him to enter the city
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: When Sheikh Alíyár arrived before the city, Muhammad Ghorni, who was dissatisfied with Hámid Khán for bringing in the Maráthás, persuaded Rúpsingh to fly. Hámid Khán, accompanied by a detachment of Marátha horse, now returned to Áhmedábád; but Muhammad Ghorni closed the gates, and would not suffer him to enter the city.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk marched to _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk marched to Mehsana.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: About this time Áli _____án, the father of the author of the Mirăt-i-Áhmedi, who was now with Mubáriz-ul-Mulk at Mehsána, advised him to conciliate the influential family of Bábi
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: About this time Áli Muhammad Khán, the father of the author of the Mirăt-i-Áhmedi, who was now with Mubáriz-ul-Mulk at Mehsána, advised him to conciliate the influential family of Bábi. Under his advice, Salábat Muhammad Khán Bábi was appointed governor of Víramgám, and Jawán Mard Khán governor of Pátan.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Under his advice, Salábat _____án Bábi was appointed governor of Víramgám, and Jawán Mard Khán governor of Pátan
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: About this time Áli Muhammad Khán, the father of the author of the Mirăt-i-Áhmedi, who was now with Mubáriz-ul-Mulk at Mehsána, advised him to conciliate the influential family of Bábi. Under his advice, Salábat Muhammad Khán Bábi was appointed governor of Víramgám, and Jawán Mard Khán governor of Pátan.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: About this time Áli _____án was dismissed from the post of minister, and in his stead first Muhammad Sayad Beg and afterwards Muhammad Sulaimán were appointed
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: About this time Áli Muhammad Khán, the father of the author of the Mirăt-i-Áhmedi, who was now with Mubáriz-ul-Mulk at Mehsána, advised him to conciliate the influential family of Bábi. Under his advice, Salábat Muhammad Khán Bábi was appointed governor of Víramgám, and Jawán Mard Khán governor of Pátan.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Shortly afterwards _____ás, the Gujaráti minister of Hámid Khán, deserted his master's declining cause
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shortly afterwards Murlidhardás, the Gujaráti minister of Hámid Khán, deserted his master's declining cause.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Before the close of _____, Mubáriz-ul-Mulk reached Áhmedábád, where he was well received by the officials and merchants
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Before the close of 1725, Mubáriz-ul-Mulk reached Áhmedábád, where he was well received by the officials and merchants.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Hámid Khán and _____áji, who had by this time reached the banks of the Mahi river, were now joined by Píláji Gáikwár
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: When Kantáji heard that Mubáriz-ul-Mulk had arrived at Pethápur, only eighteen miles from Áhmedábád, he retired to Mehmúdábád. Hámid Khán and Kantáji, who had by this time reached the banks of the Mahi river, were now joined by Píláji Gáikwár.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk deputed his son Khánahzád Khán with an army to oppose them, and made several appointments, among other changes raising Áli _____án to the post of minister
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Mubáriz-ul-Mulk deputed his son Khánahzád Khán with an army to oppose them, and made several appointments, among other changes raising Áli Muhammad Khán to the post of minister.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Defeat of the Maráthás at Sojitra and Kapadvanj, _____ Khánahzád Khán met the Maráthás near Sojitra, about ten miles north-west of Petlád, and defeated them, pursuing them as far as the Mahi
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Defeat of the Maráthás at Sojitra and Kapadvanj, 1725 Khánahzád Khán met the Maráthás near Sojitra, about ten miles north-west of Petlád, and defeated them, pursuing them as far as the Mahi.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Then, returning, he was reinforced by his brother Sháh Nawáz Khán, and marched against the Maráthás, who were encamped at _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Defeat of the Maráthás at Sojitra and Kapadvanj, 1725 Khánahzád Khán met the Maráthás near Sojitra, about ten miles north-west of Petlád, and defeated them, pursuing them as far as the Mahi. Then, returning, he was reinforced by his brother Sháh Nawáz Khán, and marched against the Maráthás, who were encamped at Kapadvanj.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Another battle was fought, and the Maráthás were again defeated and pursued as far as the hills of Áli-Mohan now _____ in the extreme east of the province
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Another battle was fought, and the Maráthás were again defeated and pursued as far as the hills of Áli-Mohan now Chhota Udaipur in the extreme east of the province.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Khánahzád Khán now appointed Hasan-ud-dín governor of Baroda, _____, Jambusar, and Makbulábád
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Khánahzád Khán now appointed Hasan-ud-dín governor of Baroda, Bharuch, Jambusar, and Makbulábád.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: The Nágars accordingly, seeing no prospect of help, paid a sum of _____ 400000 and Antáji Bháskar retired
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: The Nágars accordingly, seeing no prospect of help, paid a sum of Rupees 400000 and Antáji Bháskar retired.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Kántáji again laid siege to _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Vadnagar was inhabited by wealthy Bráhmans of the Nágar caste who prayed Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to march to their relief; but as both his sons were in pursuit of the other Marátha bands defeated at Kapadvanj, the viceroy had no troops to spare from the Áhmedábád garrison. Kántáji again laid siege to Vadnagar.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Shortly afterwards _____ in the Kaira district suffered a similar fate at the hands of Kántáji
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Shortly afterwards Umreth in the Kaira district suffered a similar fate at the hands of Kántáji.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: In one of his raids Píláji Gáikwár advancing as far as _____ was met by Khánahzád Khán, the son of the viceroy
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: In one of his raids Píláji Gáikwár advancing as far as Baroda was met by Khánahzád Khán, the son of the viceroy.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Distrusting the issue of a battle Píláji fled to _____, and from Cambay withdrew to Sorath
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: Distrusting the issue of a battle Píláji fled to Cambay, and from Cambay withdrew to Sorath.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: For these services the emperor raised Khánahzád Khán to the rank of a noble, with the title Ghálib _____
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: For these services the emperor raised Khánahzád Khán to the rank of a noble, with the title Ghálib Jang.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: Not long afterwards Áli _____án was again entrusted with a command and raised to be governor of Dholka
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: About this time Áli Muhammad Khán was dismissed from the post of minister, and in his stead first Muhammad Sayad Beg and afterwards Muhammad Sulaimán were appointed. Not long afterwards Áli Muhammad Khán was again entrusted with a command and raised to be governor of Dholka.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: The Maráthás retired to the Dakhan, but, returning in _____, compelled Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to confirm his predecessor's grants in their favour
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: The Maráthás retired to the Dakhan, but, returning in 1726, compelled Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to confirm his predecessor's grants in their favour.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: As part of the agreement between Mubáriz-ul-_____ and the Marátha chiefs Píláji was to receive a share in the revenue of the districts south of the Mahi
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.fact: The Maráthás retired to the Dakhan, but, returning in 1726, compelled Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to confirm his predecessor's grants in their favour. As part of the agreement between Mubáriz-ul-Mulk and the Marátha chiefs Píláji was to receive a share in the revenue of the districts south of the Mahi.

Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.subject: Ancient India
Gujarat under Muhammad Shah.question: About this time want of funds forced Mubáriz-ul-Mulk to sell the greater part of the _____ district to different landholders
